The letter D is printed at the upper left. A thin green line borders the lower edge. Panel E: Axial PET slice in an inverted grayscale (dark = uptake) showing a cluster of dark foci, one larger, in the image-right chest region on a pale grey body outline. The letter E is printed at the upper left. Panel F: Axial PET slice in an inverted grayscale showing three small discrete dark foci near the midline and image-right chest on a pale grey body outline. The letter F is printed at the upper left.

visual.general_description: Seven-panel FDG PET/CT: fused orbit and liver slices (A,B), CT (C,D), axial PET (E,F) and a whole-body PET projection (G).
visual.detailed_description: Seven panels: a two-by-two block of fused and CT axial slices, two axial PET slices, and a tall whole-body PET projection at the right. Panel A: Axial fused PET/CT slice through the orbits and skull base with a pink-orange overlay; a bright yellow-green focus lies at the upper right of the image at the level of an orbit. Black air-containing regions are visible in the sinuses and mastoid areas. The letter A is printed at the upper left. Panel B: Axial fused PET/CT slice through the upper abdomen with a red overlay across the liver and a small bright green focus within it; ribs, spine and upper limbs are visible. The letter B is printed at the upper left. Thin green lines border the lower edge. Panel C: Axial CT slice through the orbits and skull base in a bone-like window showing orbits, sinuses and mastoid air spaces, with no colour overlay. The letter C is printed at the upper left. Panel D: Axial CT slice through the upper abdomen in a soft-tissue window showing liver, spleen region, ribs, spine and upper limbs, with no colour overlay. The letter D is printed at the upper left. A thin green line borders the lower edge. Panel E: Axial PET slice at the orbit level in inverted grayscale with one round black focus at the upper right of the image. The letter E is printed at the upper left of the panel. Panel F: Axial PET slice at the upper abdomen level in inverted grayscale with one small black focus near the upper centre of the image. The letter F is printed at the upper left of the panel. Panel G: Whole-body projection PET image in inverted grayscale of a standing figure with arms at the sides. Several dark foci cluster in the chest, with further scattered dark foci along the midline and in the lower abdomen and pelvis; a dark rounded region lies at the bladder level and a curved dark outline lies in the abdomen. The letter G is printed at the upper left. A thin pink line borders the top edge.

visual.general_description: Four light-microscopy fields of the bronchoscopic biopsy: three H&E and one cytokeratin immunostain, two with printed cell-type labels.
visual.detailed_description: Four panels in a two-by-two layout. Panel A: Microscopy field with purple-stained cellular tissue and a red-stained area of packed red cells at the left edge; the cells have variable nuclei and pink cytoplasm. The letter A is printed at the upper left. Panel B: Microscopy field of cells with brown cytoplasmic staining on a blue-counterstained background, with some unstained empty space at the right. The letter B is printed at the upper left. Panel C: Microscopy field of pink-purple elongated cells arranged in sheets and streaming bundles. A white rectangular label with the text Spindle cells and two white arrows are drawn over the image. The letter C is printed at the upper left. Panel D: Microscopy field of pink-purple cells including larger rounded cells, with a tissue edge at the upper right. A white rectangular label with the text Giant cells and two white arrows are drawn over the image. The letter D is printed at the upper left.
